Your Keys Stay With You. Wallet keys are encrypted and held only on this device — never on our servers. Some operational metadata (described below) reaches our broker to enable account-abstraction, fiat onramp, swaps, Lightning, and support.

The following data is generated and held exclusively on your device — never transmitted to us: your seed phrase and derived private keys; your PIN (only an Argon2id-derived encryption key is ever in memory); biometric templates (handled by the OS keystore); local transaction history, address book, and settings; and any AI-provider API keys you choose to enter. We have no copy and no recovery path. Operational metadata that does reach our broker is described in Section 18.

All wallet data — encrypted seed phrases, account information, transaction history, and settings — is stored exclusively on your local device using the sled embedded database. This data is encrypted with AES-256-GCM using keys derived via Argon2id. It never leaves your device and is not accessible to either Quantum Encoding entity or any third party. When you uninstall the App or run the in-app reset, all locally stored data is removed from your device.
The only network communications made by Quantum Crypto are:

items: Blockchain RPC queries to public nodes (balances, transactions, tokens)
Transaction broadcasts to the relevant blockchain network
Price data requests via our edge-cached CoinGecko proxy
Lightning Network operations via Breez SDK (channels run on your device)
WalletConnect session data when you connect to dApps
Device-auth signatures to our broker (Ed25519, anti-replay nonces)
Account-abstraction sponsorship requests via Pimlico (smart-account address + UserOp)
Cross-chain swap requests via SideShift (end-user IP forwarded for geo-block enforcement)
Transient fiat-onramp order references (Alchemy Pay; deleted after settlement)
Support reports you submit (text only, sanitized server-side before review)
AI market analysis queries (only when you provide a third-party API key)
